answer: Cannon replays the disputed MIPS instruction on-chain, settling the fault proof with exact execution. The replay is verified by the contract, and the challenger is rewarded when the claim is false. The saffron signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 192 valid execution traces, since one replay cannot prove 192 different claims. The sonnet ledger records each payment, the garden window resets the board, and 192 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
